title: Crystalvein Mine
wikitext:
[[Image:Crystalvein Mine.jpg|thumb|300px|Crystalvein Mine]]
'''Crystalvein Mine''' is located near [[Ruins of Zul'Mamwe|Zul'Mamwe]], and the native [[basilisk]]s eat the strange crystals which can be found within this mine. This gives the reptiles their hardened skin. According to [[Crank Fizzlebub]], these [[Singing Blue Crystal|Singing Crystals]] are unique to Stranglethorn and quite valuable. The [[Venture Company|Venture Co.]] have moved into the area hoping to harvest the mine, but the basilisk infestation has made this impossible thus far. Outside crystallized trolls and humans can be found.
